              │    a                 add an item to this project                     │
              │    A                 add an item to several projects                 │
              │    e                 edit the note in $EDITOR                        │
              │    n                 rename the item                                 │
              │    x                 archive the item                                │
              │    P                 choose the projects the item is filed in        │
              │    b                 link an item this one waits on                  │
              │    B                 unlink an item this one waits on                │
              │    M                 move the item, then j and k, Enter to drop      │
              │    C                 open a Claude session on the item               │
              │    t                 add a task to the item                          │
              │    T                 open the dependency map on the item             │
              │                                                                      │
              │    Views and filters                                                 │
              │    Tab               the next view                                   │
              │    Shift+Tab         the previous view                               │
              │    /                 filter the list, matching notes too             │
              │    1                 show only blocked items, or every one again     │
              │    2                 show archived items too, or hide them again     │
              │    .                 show or hide shelved and closed projects        │
              │                                                                      │
              │    Everywhere                                                        │
              │    u                 undo the last change                            │
              │    R                 read the data again now                         │
              │    ?                 show these keys                                 │
              │    q Ctrl+c          quit                                            │
              │                                                                      │
              │    [Esc] or [?] Close                                                │
              │                                                                      │
              ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
